title: Day 694: Two Killed in Separate Culiacán Attacks — Nissan Versa Ambush in Colonia Miguel Hidalgo and Pink-Pig-Toy Signature Killing in Culiacancito
detail:
On June 17, 2026, two men traveling in a Nissan Versa were attacked with automatic weapons on a street in Colonia Miguel Hidalgo, central Culiacán. Sebastián "N" (21) died at the scene; his companion José Luis "N" (19) was wounded and taken to hospital by Red Cross personnel. Shots struck the windshield and driver's door.

Separately, Army and State Preventive Police elements found Jesús Lorenzo "N" (62) dead of gunshot wounds inside a house on Callejón Hacienda in the Culiacancito area, with a pink plush pig toy placed next to the body — a signature marker local reporters say has now accompanied at least seven killings in the conflict.

media.caption: Military patrols continue in Sinaloa amid a day of armed clashes that left two dead in Culiacán, June 17, 2026
